code_first.q: Predict one adjacent swap of two example file sizes in a bubble-sort pass.
code_first.code:
leftMB = 7
rightMB = 2
if leftMB > rightMB then
    temp = leftMB
    leftMB = rightMB
    rightMB = temp
endif
print(leftMB)
p: Predict the value printed after the comparison.
Change rightMB to 10 and predict again.
State which values are compared by bubble sort and how to calculate combined file storage.
code_first.a: 7 > 2 so the values swap; leftMB becomes 2 and is printed. With rightMB 10 there is no swap and 7 prints. Bubble sort compares neighbouring elements. Total file storage requires adding the file sizes, e.g. 7+2=9 MB.
